sloka: तत: पुरुषसिंहानां वृतानां तै: सुहृद्गणै: ।शोचतामेव रजनी दु:खेन व्यत्यवर्त्तत ॥ २.१०५.१॥
transliteration: tata: puruṣasiṁhānāṁ vṛtānāṁ tai: suhṛdgaṇai: ।śocatāmeva rajanī du:khena vyatyavarttata ॥ 2.105.1॥

translations.english: That night passed off painfully for the four lion like brothers as they lamented, surrounded by their hosts of friends.
